domain_specific_rationale: As QA Specialist with mandatory signoff authority, I strongly endorse providing the standalone, zero-external-dependency `verify_package.py` verification tool. It enables fully automated, deterministic validation of candidate manifests, individual file hashes, tree hashes, and archive digests in CI/CD pipelines and local pre-freeze verification. This eliminates manual verification errors and fulfills the strict acceptance criteria set forth in our Definition of Done.
capability_impact: Directly implements and certifies CAP-14 (Release Integrity & Governance) and ensures reliable verification of release candidate artifacts.
residual_risk: Python runtime differences across execution environments; mitigated by restricting implementation strictly to Python 3 standard library modules (hashlib, json, sys, os, pathlib).
